primary_benchmark: XJTU-SY, all 15 bearing runs under three operating conditions
retrieval: Public mirror pinned to revision 2742263; raw archive SHA256 and per-snapshot provenance retained
primary_target: Minutes to the final recorded snapshot; no claim that this is an independently adjudicated catastrophic-failure timestamp
target_transform: log1p during training; expm1 and nonnegative clipping for predictions
main_final_fit: Runs 1â€“4 of each condition after selecting hyperparameters exclusively on run 4; evaluate once on run 5
transfer_protocol: Three leave-one-operating-condition-out evaluations. Within each outer fold, use only source-condition runs 1â€“3 for fitting and source-condition run 4 for selection; refit using all five runs of source conditions, then test all five target-condition runs. No target-condition labels used for fitting or selection.
primary_selection_metric: Unweighted mean of per-bearing MAE in minutes on validation bearings
training_weights: Each training bearing has equal total sample weight
basic: Per-channel mean, standard deviation and RMS; elapsed observed minutes, rpm and radial load
engineered: Basic plus impulsiveness, distribution, spectral, envelope and rotation-order band descriptors
normalisation: Per-bearing healthy-baseline assumption: use the first ten snapshots only to form median and median absolute deviation scales. Predict/evaluate only snapshots after these ten. Target labels and future snapshots are never used in this transformation.
baselines: Condition-specific training median lifetime minus observed elapsed time
metrics: Per-bearing MAE and RMSE in minutes
Near-endpoint screening recall/precision at 30 minutes, explicitly a proxy rather than fault ground truth
explanation: Exact XGBoost Tree SHAP native pred_contribs, tree-path-dependent training leaf background; explain the validation-selected engineered XGBoost candidate separately if another family wins. Report log1p-minute output, additivity error, global and condition-wise rankings; no causal claims.
uncertainty: Descriptive 90th-percentile absolute residual band estimated from the pre-refit validation model; refitting, temporal dependence and few bearings preclude nominal coverage guarantees. Report actual held-out coverage.

maintenance_scenarios.interpretation: Explicitly assumed unit-cost and discarded-life scenarios, not measured monetary or environmental results; no CO2 or lifecycle savings claims

persistence: Atomic model/metrics writes, per-task completion manifest, data/config hashes, resumable RF tree batches and XGBoost iteration checkpoints; immutable connector snapshots and Colab Drive mirroring
limitations: Operating condition changes rpm and load together
engineering_geometry: Geometry-independent shaft-order bands, envelope statistics and broadband descriptors; no assumed defect-frequency geometry.
change_record: Implementation clarification before any training; prediction target, splits, candidate budgets and selection metric unchanged.
